g.text: Recorder power / Mini-Box PWR-DCDC-USB to Raspberry Pi 4B

g.title: USB-C
g.text: Source/CC hardware, gauge and length TBD.

g.title: checkout
g.text: Confirm the 5 V setting for the board revision.
Power-cycle, then meter polarity at the plug.
Verify 5 V with a 3 A dummy load at the plug.

g.title: board_map
g.text: View from above · mini-USB at upper right
Slash-separated contact numbers share a net.
Verify populated cavities and plug orientation.

g.title: ignition
g.text: Key-off test · keep dummy load connected
Select automotive mode and a finite HARDOFF above zero.
Time IGN loss → PSW pulse → loss of 5 V at plug.
PSW needs a Pi-compatible interface. Allow time for
SSD file close and OS halt before power falls.
